name: Self-Evolution Periodic Trigger
description: Triggers Doraemon's self-reflection after agent stops, analyzing conversation quality and extracting learnings

then.prompt:
Quick self-reflection: Review the conversation that just ended. In 2-3 sentences, note:
1. What went well (response quality, helpfulness)
2. What could improve (missed intent, wrong tone, incomplete answer)
3. Any pattern worth remembering

Store this as a brief internal note. Do NOT modify any files. Do NOT execute any commands. This is READ-ONLY reflection only. Keep it under 100 words.
